stage1.impression: A red acrylic trough floating on a wall of pinkish, evenly lit timber boards. The sink's body is a black slab and the only red is a thin glossy film on its top, through which the wall's planks ghost. The wall under it is the brightest thing in the frame, and the spout looks like a chrome door lever stuck to the boards. It reads as a real-time CG product shot, not a photograph. A design magazine would not run it as a specific place: nothing in the frame says listening bar, Planet EARF or San Francisco, only a generic red vanity.

blocking_9: The sink must glow through its thickness: front and end faces ember red with a brighter polished edge, not a black slab (front face lum_median >= 30, now 3.9)
The timber must read as dark, aged boards (stain variation between boards, checks, end grain, nail holes) and not as one procedural grain texture with a pink cast
The wall must not be the brightest surface: a pool of light on the basin and spout, with the boards falling off into shadow
No dead black band: the left 100 px (13.9 % of the frame) is 85 % crushed
The spout must read as brushed steel set into the wall, not a polished lever floating on the boards
Some sign of life and of the place (a towel, soap, the bar's light spilling in) so the detail belongs to this room

defects.what: Sink front and underside nearly black (lum_median 3.9, crush 47 %); the acrylic shows no glow through its thickness despite the under-glow
Wall planks ghost through the red top (the gloss reflection reads as transparency); thin glossy-plastic look, no depth to the tint
The trough's end edge is soft and dull (step 18.8, 10-90 width 26 px); no polished, glowing acrylic edge
Dead black band down the left (lum_median 1.1, crush 85 %), larger than a tenth of the frame
Timber wall flat and evenly lit (lum_median 52, range 41), one repeating procedural grain, mauve-pink cast, no checks, nail holes or stain variation
Wall below the sink is the brightest area of the frame (p95 109), so the light washes the boards instead of the sink
Spout reads as a polished chrome lever with no rose or escutcheon, a red smear on its underside, floating on the boards
A lone, featureless dark bottle is the only prop; no sign of life
Overall softness and CG-smooth surfaces; no grain or atmosphere

changes.expected: Front and end faces read as deep ember red, brighter at the bottom edge and the polished arrises, and the wall spill drops relative to the sink

changes.problem: The timber reads as a bright, flat, pinkish procedural texture, not dark boards.
